zh.title: 美國成立航管應變小組，感恩節前預估單日逾5.2萬架次航班
zh.summary: 美國11月13日因航管通訊設備不穩而暫停全國航班起飛。白宮成立跨部門小組防範故障重演；美國聯邦航空總署預估，感恩節疏運期間最繁忙的一天是11月24日。
body: 美國交通部11月23日表示，白宮已成立跨部門小組，防範感恩節疏運期間再度發生航管系統故障。小組由美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）、交通部、國防部及國家情報總監辦公室派員組成。
FAA表示，11月13日因既有通訊設備運作不穩，為安全起見一度暫停全國航班起飛。當時部分無線電頻率與雷達資料仍可使用，並非所有通訊和雷達都中斷。這次成立小組是預防措施，不是宣布新的全國起飛禁令。
FAA預估，感恩節前後九天將有超過41.7萬架次航班，11月24日將是最忙的一天，預計超過5.2萬架次。這是預測值，不是實際飛航統計。美國交通部建議旅客出發前向航空公司確認航班，並透過FAA網站查詢即時機場狀況。

en.title: U.S. forms air traffic control task force ahead of Thanksgiving flight peak
en.summary: The White House formed an interagency team after unstable air traffic communications prompted a nationwide ground stop on November 13. The FAA expects November 24 to be the busiest day of the Thanksgiving travel period.
body: The U.S. Department of Transportation said on November 23 that the White House had assembled an interagency task force to prevent another air traffic control disruption during Thanksgiving travel. The team includes officials from the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), the Departments of Transportation and Defense, and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence.

The FAA said instability in its legacy communications equipment prompted a precautionary nationwide ground stop on November 13. Some radio frequencies and radar feeds remained available, so the incident was not a complete loss of communications or radar. The task force is a preventive measure, not a new ground stop.

The FAA forecasts more than 417,000 flights over the nine-day holiday period and expects November 24 to be the busiest day, with more than 52,000 flights. The figures are forecasts, not counts of flights already operated. The Transportation Department advised travelers to check with their airline and use the FAA’s real-time airport status service.

zh.title: Allegiant Air取消3座機場的17條航線
zh.summary: Allegiant Air取消3座機場的17條航線，飛機調往收益較高的休閒航線。
body: Allegiant Air取消從3座最繁忙的機場出發的17條航線。Simple Flying於2026年11月23日刊出的報導指出，這家以內華達為基地的超低成本航空公司正停飛載客率偏低的航線服務。
Allegiant Air也將飛機重新部署至收益較高的休閒旅遊航線。報導指出，這些營運調整是在費用上升的背景下進行。

en.title: Allegiant Air Cancels 17 Routes From Three Airports
en.summary: Allegiant Air cancels 17 routes from three airports and redeploys aircraft to higher-yield leisure routes.
body: Allegiant Air is canceling a total of 17 routes from three of the busiest airports, according to a Simple Flying report published on November 23, 2026. The airline, which is based in Nevada, operates as an ultra-low-cost carrier and is shutting services that have low load factors.
The carrier is also redeploying aircraft to leisure travel corridors that offer a higher yield. The changes are taking place against a backdrop of rising fees, the report said.

zh.title: 捷藍航空A321neo因尾部撞擊仍停場於洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）
zh.summary: 捷藍航空A321neo因尾部撞擊仍停場；返航失敗；乘客滯留
body: 捷藍航空的空中巴士A321neo仍停在洛杉磯國際機場（LAX），因在深夜執行返航時發生尾部撞擊，事故被攝影機錄下。機組在返航過程中未能順利降落，導致機尾觸碰跑道，隨即決定將飛機留在機場檢修。
根據報導，這次返航原本是為了執行一班深夜紅眼航班，但因撞擊事件被迫中止，乘客被滯留在機場。航班被取消，乘客需另作安排。
截至目前，航空公司尚未公佈修復時間表，該架A321neo仍保持停場狀態，相關調查仍在進行中。

en.title: JetBlue A321neo grounded at LAX after late‑night tail strike
en.summary: JetBlue A321neo grounded; tail strike captured; go‑around aborted red‑eye flight at LAX
body: JetBlue’s Airbus A321neo remains grounded at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) after a late‑night tail strike was captured on video during a go‑around. The aircraft’s tail contacted the runway while the crew attempted to land, prompting the airline to keep the plane at the airport for inspection.

According to the report, the go‑around was part of a red‑eye flight that was aborted after the incident, leaving the jet stranded. The flight was cancelled and passengers were required to make alternative arrangements.
JetBlue has not yet released a timeline for repairs, and the A321neo stays out of service while investigations continue.
